mo_ta_cong_viec:
We're looking for a highly creative Artist/Designer Intern who can turn ideas into sketches, illustrations, and visual concepts quickly.
You’ll work closely with our team to transform ideas and business requirements into clear and engaging visual outputs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys drawing, exploring different visual styles, and bringing creative ideas to life.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on real projects and collaborate with clients, developers, AI engineers, and other technical team members. You don't need to know everything from day one — we're looking for someone with strong creative thinking, good visual instincts, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.
 
What You'll Do
Turn ideas, concepts, and requirements into sketches, illustrations, and visual concepts.
Create visual materials for social media, presentations, marketing activities, and other company needs.
Develop initial sketches and visual directions based on briefs and discussions.
Explore different styles, compositions, and approaches to communicate an idea effectively.
Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute fresh and creative ideas.
Work closely with clients to understand their ideas and translate them into visual concepts.
Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and technical teams to understand project requirements and creative possibilities.
Take feedback from team members and clients and refine your work accordingly.
Experiment with AI-powered creative tools and explore new ways of incorporating AI into the creative process.
Support the team in developing visual concepts for real-world projects and products.
Build and maintain a portfolio of work throughout your internship.
yeu_cau:
Requirements
Strong drawing and illustration skills.
A creative mindset with strong visual imagination.
Ability to quickly visualize an idea and turn it into a sketch or visual concept.
Good understanding of visual composition, shapes, proportions, and storytelling.
Ability to communicate ideas visually and explain your creative thinking.
A portfolio showcasing your creativity, drawing, illustration, or visual design work.
Good English communication skills.
Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and experiment with new creative approaches.
Interest in AI-powered creative tools is a plus.
What You'll Learn
How to turn business ideas and client requirements into visual concepts.
How to communicate and collaborate with clients and technical teams.
How creative work fits into real product and software development projects.
How to develop visual concepts from an initial idea through to a final output.
How to use AI-powered creative tools to support and enhance the creative process.
How to build a professional portfolio based on real projects.
Benefits
Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
Opportunity to work directly with clients and learn how to understand business requirements.
Collaboration with developers, AI engineers, and other technical team members.
Hands-on experience through real projects rather than only practice assignments.
Opportunity to work on a variety of creative tasks and explore different visual styles.
Build and strengthen your professional portfolio.
Explore and experiment with AI-powered creative tools.
Internship allowance - 3,000,000 VND/month.
Opportunity to develop your skills in a real working environment.
 
Who You'll Fit In
You’ll fit well in this role if you naturally enjoy turning abstract ideas into something visual. You don't need to wait for a perfectly detailed brief - you’re comfortable asking questions, sketching your ideas, trying different approaches, and improving your work based on feedback.
quyen_loi:
Perks & benefits for well-being and balance
Access to top tech and modern engineering
A culture of growth, collaboration & learning

8seneca is committed to building a workplace where employees can grow, contribute, and thrive.
1. Engaging perks and benefits for your well-being
We offer a competitive package including 13th-month salary, on-time salary payments, and project bonuses based on revenue. Employees are fully covered with 100% salary-based insurance, advanced healthcare insurance, annual health check-ups, and Tet/holiday gifts.
Work-life balance is supported with 14 days annual leave plus 3 Christmas days, flexible working arrangements (3 days WFH for senior lever up), modern office facilities, team-building trips (4D3N at 5-star resorts), and wellness support such as vitamins in the office. In addition, the office provides coffee machines, snacks, and fresh fruits to support daily comfort and energy.
2. World-class technology and impactful projects
You will work with modern technologies in AI, Data, Cloud, and Software Engineering on large-scale international projects for European clients, including strategic initiatives for our company—one of the top IT companies in Europe. We also provide access to modern AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude Code to support productivity and engineering excellence.
3. A culture of growth, collaboration, and learning
We foster continuous learning through mentorship programs, 1-1 feedback, and performance reviews. Employees are empowered to take ownership, make decisions, and learn from mistakes in a safe, supportive environment. A shared company library also promotes continuous self-development.
At 8seneca, you will work with talented people from diverse backgrounds, united by a passion for technology and innovation.
